{"reason": "alert-planner (35000, always on time) dominates suggest-alternative-supplier (45000, often late): train rows show 4 stockouts at inventory-days 2.8–5.3 and 34 costly switches. Routing every medium/high risk to alert-planner cuts cost from 2.165M to ~1.23M and stockouts 4→0, satisfying the business gate.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high)) (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
